_comment: wikilogger all-in-one (Postgres + Redis + bot) for Pterodactyl.
name: wikilogger (All-in-One)
author: tomwbloomer@gmail.com
description: Logger v3 (fee1-dead/wikilogger fork) — a Discord audit-logging bot. Bundles PostgreSQL, Redis and the bot in one container via supervisord; all state lives under /home/container. Needs the Server Members and Message Content privileged intents enabled on the Discord application.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
echo 'wikilogger image is self-contained; nothing to install.'

variables.name: Bot Token
variables.description: Discord bot token from the Bot tab of your application. Raw token, no 'Bot ' prefix.

variables.name: Creator ID
variables.description: Your Discord user ID. Required to run the hidden owner commands, above all 'setcmd global', which registers the slash commands. A single ID only — the upstream code compares this field directly.

variables.name: Enable Text Commands
variables.description: Set to 'true' to enable the prefix commands, which is how slash commands get registered (see the README). Leave blank to disable — any non-empty value counts as enabled, including 'false'.

variables.name: Command Prefix
variables.description: Prefix for the text commands, e.g. 'v3' makes the register command 'v3setcmd global'.

variables.name: AES Key
variables.description: Key used to encrypt logged message content in the database. Leave blank and one is generated on first boot and kept in /home/container/aes.key. Changing it makes already-stored messages unreadable.

variables.name: Message Batch Size
variables.description: How many cached messages to flush to Postgres per batch.

variables.name: Redis Lock TTL
variables.description: Milliseconds a shard holds the Redis startup lock while connecting. Raise it if shards fight over identify slots.

variables.name: Error Webhook URL
variables.description: Optional Discord webhook URL for the bot's own error and status notifications. Blank disables the notifier.

variables.name: Sentry DSN
variables.description: Optional Sentry DSN for exception reporting. Blank disables Sentry.

variables.name: Paste Endpoint
variables.description: Optional haste-server style POST endpoint used by /archive and bulk-delete logs. Blank means those features error out.

variables.name: Paste Token
variables.description: Optional Authorization header value sent to the paste endpoint.
